3 photographs attached, in order:
  1. front three-quarter from the forecourt: long Beaux-Arts facade with arches, mansard roofs and the tall clock tower, daylight
  2. high view looking down along the station's train shed roofs and tracks
  3. view of the long arcaded facade and mansard roof from the other end, tower out of frame, daylight

json.notes: Differences: (1) the train sheds read as one flat, merged sheet; the real roofs are several separate parallel barrels with clear gaps and rise higher above the eaves. (2) The clock tower is too narrow and too low at its shaft, and its dome is too small for the real tower's presence. (3) The Beaux-Arts front block is too low and its mansard too shallow to match the tall roofline of the facade.
